name: Divider
purpose: A horizontal rule that separates content, with weights matching the hierarchy of the separation (within a subsection, between sections, or a stronger break). On-light and on-dark.

props.name: variant
props.$note: subsection/subsection-inset/section = 1px; break = 4px. subsection-inset is indented by padding/responsive/medium.

variants.name: subsection
variants.use: Lightest 1px rule separating items within a subsection (#ededed light).

variants.name: subsection-inset
variants.use: As subsection but inset/indented by padding/responsive/medium (16).

variants.name: section
variants.use: Slightly stronger 1px rule between sections (#d7d8d6 light).

variants.name: break
variants.use: Thicker 4px rule for a stronger visual break.

tokens.thickness: subsection/inset/section = 1px; break = 4px (border-width not tokenised here — literal heights)

build.flexibleWidth: Build with flexible widths to accommodate different screen sizes (per the Dividers guide).

accessibility.semantics: REVIEW (inferred): decorative dividers should be hidden from assistive tech; if a divider conveys a meaningful grouping boundary, expose it as a separator (role=separator)
accessibility.contrast: Divider colours are subtle by design (1.x:1) — acceptable for non-essential decoration, but don't rely on a divider alone to convey structure

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): overusing dividers where whitespace would group content adequately
Leaving the on-dark divider bound to the deprecated non-interactive border tokens — rebind to the mode-aware divider/border/* (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — on-light clean; on-dark uses 2 deprecated tokens

depricateUsage.migrationPath: The live divider/border/* tokens are MODE-AWARE (carry dark values too), so the on-dark divider should rebind to the SAME divider/border/* tokens as on-light rather than the deprecated non-interactive borders. Same fix-pattern as Button on-dark. (These deprecated border neutrals also block Avatar — no standalone live equivalent, but divider/border/* covers the divider case.)
